inherited_urban.en: Pre-1979 county town and villages (retain inherited low-rise fabric)
inherited_urban.zh: 1979 年前既有县城与村落（保留低层肌理）

built_1984.en: Completed or occupied 1980–84 urban blocks (replace 1980 farmland with built urban ground)
built_1984.zh: 1980–84 年已建成或投入使用的城市街块（替代 1980 年农田为建成城市地表）

graded_works.en: Active site grading and construction yards ('five connections and one levelling'; replace 1980 farmland with red-ochre graded earth)
graded_works.zh: 正在平整及施工的“五通一平”工地（替代 1980 年农田为红褐色平整土方地表）

civic_park.en: Documented civic compounds and urban parks (replace 1980 farmland with civic grounds and tree canopy)
civic_park.zh: 有据可查的机关院落与城市公园（替代 1980 年农田为院落与绿树林荫）

transport_yard.en: Railway yards, stations and border port aprons (transport ground, never farmland)
transport_yard.zh: 铁路站场、车站与口岸场地（交通用地，不作农田）

retained_farm.en: Preserved 1984 agricultural lowlands and reserve fringes (keep interpreted field cover)
retained_farm.zh: 1984 年保留农田与外围预留地（保持判读农田覆盖）
